from pathlib import Path


def replace_once(path: Path, old: str, new: str) -> None:
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    count = text.count(old)
    if count != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Expected one patch target in {path}, found {count}: {old[:120]!r}"
        )
    path.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1), encoding="utf-8")


cache = Path("src/aspenops_nexus/cache.py")
replace_once(cache, "from typing import Any\n", "from typing import Any, cast\n")
replace_once(
    cache,
    "            [(count, key) for key, count in self._pending_hits.items()],\n",
    "            ((count, key) for key, count in self._pending_hits.items()),\n",
)
replace_once(
    cache,
    "                decoded[key] = {str(name): item for name, item in value.items()}\n",
    "                decoded[key] = cast(dict[str, Any], value)\n",
)
replace_once(
    cache,
    "    def stats(self) -> dict[str, int]:\n",
    '''    def close(self) -> None:
        """Persist pending hit accounting; cache connections remain operation-scoped."""
        with self._lock, closing(self._connect()) as connection, connection:
            self._flush_hits(connection)

    def stats(self) -> dict[str, int]:
''',
)

pool = Path("src/aspenops_nexus/pool.py")
replace_once(pool, "from dataclasses import dataclass, replace\n", "from dataclasses import dataclass\n")
replace_once(pool, "from typing import Any\n", "from typing import Any, cast\n")
replace_once(
    pool,
    '''        for handle in handles:
            stop_worker(handle)

    def _new_handle(self, worker_id: int) -> WorkerHandle:
''',
    '''        for handle in handles:
            stop_worker(handle)
        self.cache.close()

    def _new_handle(self, worker_id: int) -> WorkerHandle:
''',
)
replace_once(
    pool,
    "                                output[index] = replace(cancelled)\n",
    "                                output[index] = deepcopy(cancelled)\n",
)
replace_once(
    pool,
    '''                except BaseException as exc:
                    with result_lock:
                        errors.append(exc)
                finally:
                    tasks.task_done()
''',
    '''                except BaseException as exc:
                    with result_lock:
                        errors.append(exc)
''',
)
text = pool.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
old_return = "return [item for item in output if item is not None]"
if text.count(old_return) != 2:
    raise RuntimeError("Expected two validated output-copy returns in pool.py")
pool.write_text(
    text.replace(old_return, "return cast(list[EvaluationResult], output)"),
    encoding="utf-8",
)

worker = Path("src/aspenops_nexus/worker.py")
replace_once(worker, "import uuid\n", "import uuid\nfrom copy import deepcopy\n")
replace_once(
    worker,
    '''    result.worker_id = handle.worker_id
    handle.evaluations += 1
    result.diagnostics.setdefault("worker", {})
    result.diagnostics["worker"].update(
        {
            "generation": handle.generation,
            "round_trip_s": time.perf_counter() - sent_at,
            "runtime": handle.runtime,
        }
    )
    return result
''',
    '''    result.worker_id = handle.worker_id
    handle.evaluations += 1
    worker_diagnostics = result.diagnostics.get("worker")
    if not isinstance(worker_diagnostics, dict):
        worker_diagnostics = {}
        result.diagnostics["worker"] = worker_diagnostics
    worker_diagnostics.update(
        {
            "generation": handle.generation,
            "round_trip_s": time.perf_counter() - sent_at,
            "runtime": deepcopy(handle.runtime),
        }
    )
    return result
''',
)
